visual_checks.name: tile_grid_seams
visual_checks.evidence: All three diff10 images show extreme tile-correlated structured patterns — dense checkerboard/quilting artifacts far beyond acceptable noise. Side and top diff10 show uniform high-amplitude colored blocks tightly aligned to 32-pixel boundaries.

visual_checks.name: tile_uniform_fill
visual_checks.evidence: Side render shows large regions of constant dark-blue rectangular blocks where reference has smooth surface detail. Top render shows severe 32×32 tile-shaped color patches with pink/orange contamination that does not exist in reference.

visual_checks.name: missing_splat_holes
visual_checks.evidence: Side view render is dramatically darker overall than reference — large regions that should have coverage are nearly black, indicating wholesale splat dropout across multiple tile regions.

visual_checks.name: color_clipping_bands
visual_checks.evidence: Top render shows bright orange/pink saturated regions in the upper area (near ear/antenna) that are absent from the reference. Color values are clearly out-of-range for those regions.

visual_checks.name: ringing_halos
visual_checks.evidence: No distinct ringing or halo artifacts visible at silhouette edges beyond the general tile-corruption noise.

visual_checks.name: nan_inf_signatures
visual_checks.evidence: No pure magenta/white/black patches in spatially-correlated patches consistent with NaN/Inf. Corruption appears to be numerical drift rather than NaN propagation.

visual_checks.name: geometry_shift
visual_checks.evidence: Diff10 does not show a clean silhouette edge pattern indicating geometry shift. Object is present at correct location in all views.

visual_checks.name: diff10_structure
visual_checks.evidence: All three diff10 images are dominated by highly structured tile-correlated patterns (dense colored checkerboard blocks), not uniform speckle. This is the signature of catastrophic per-tile state corruption, consistent with tile_structure_ratio max of 23.08.

reasoning: REJECT on multiple hard gates. (1) PSNR catastrophic: all three views are in the 23-27 dB range, 10-15 dB below the 38 dB kernel-algebra floor — this is not architectural baseline drift but a wholesale rendering failure. (2) tile_structure_ratio max 23.08 (top view), delta +5.08 vs architectural baseline ~17-18 — far exceeds the +0.3 ratchet limit. (3) Visual inspection confirms the failure: side render shows severe 32×32 uniform-fill dark blocks with detail lost; top render shows pink/orange color contamination in large tile-shaped regions; all diff10 images show extreme tile-correlated structured noise rather than uniform speckle. Dropping same-RISC cb_wait_fronts has caused per-tile state corruption — data races between reader and compute on the same RISC are apparently load-bearing synchronization, not redundant waits. The timing win (-5.2%) is real but irrelevant given the quality collapse.
